body_html:
Born in Atlanta and raised in Gary, Indiana, Danny T has been bringing unforgettable energy to events since he first stepped behind the decks in 2012. With a background in hosting private events, fashion shows, birthday parties, and more, Danny blends professionalism with an approachable, high-vibe style that clients love.

What Drew Danny to DJing

Danny was captivated early on by the electric energy that comes from mixing and blending music. The art of scratching records, the creativity of transitions, and the ability to move a crowd all play a big part in what fuels his passion behind the turntables.

What’s in His Headphones

Danny’s musical palette spans almost every genre—Hip Hop, House, Reggaeton, Country, Rock, and Afrobeats. This diverse range makes him a versatile DJ who can read any crowd and adapt instantly to the moment.

Best Part About DJing

For Danny, nothing compares to bringing people together to enjoy a shared moment on the dance floor. Creating joy, connection, and memories is what drives his craft every single event.

Favorite Events to DJ

Danny thrives at theme parties—whether it’s the 70s, 80s, 90s, or special themed celebrations of all kinds. His creativity and energy shine brightest when he’s helping bring a theme to life.

Go-To Dance Floor Fillers

Expect to hear high-energy party favorites, Pitbull anthems, the Cupid Shuffle, and other guaranteed crowd-pleasers when Danny is in control of the vibe.

Beyond the Booth

Danny is a proud husband and father of four boys. When he’s not DJing, he’s cheering on the Georgia Bulldogs, coaching his kids’ flag football teams, or binge-watching movies and TV shows with his family.
A true multi-talent, Danny is also a gifted musician—he plays the keyboard, drums, and bass guitar, and he both sings and raps. Music isn’t just a job for him; it’s part of who he is.
